annotations.title: asksteps: the building blocks, conditions, template format and limits for processes, templates and appointment types

description: Returns what you need to build processes, message templates and appointment types without guessing: the process building-block kinds with exits, references and settings schema, the condition types, the delivery values, the message template block types (without "html", which only a person sets) with their limits, the shortcodes with contexts and visitor suitability, and the limits of an appointment type. Product knowledge only, no account data. Call it before asksteps_create_process, asksteps_create_message_template or asksteps_create_appointment_type. Requires "automation:read".
name: asksteps_get_automation_catalog

appointmentType.description: The limits and choices of an appointment type.

maxClosingTextLength.description: The closing text of a way to attend has at most this many characters.

maxExcludedDates.description: At most this many excluded days.

maxKeyLength.description: A key is lowercase letters, digits and "-", this many characters at most.

maxModes.description: At most this many ways to attend per appointment type.

ranges.description: Allowed range of every numeric field.

conditionFormat.description: How a condition of a transition is written, with an example.

conditions.description: The condition types a transition may use, with the data contexts they need and their parameter schema.

contexts.description: The data contexts the condition needs.

type.description: The type, as written in "type" of a condition.

deliveries.description: The values of "delivery" of a transition: "direct", "email", "team".

maxEdges.description: At most this many transitions per process.

maxParts.description: At most this many building blocks per process.

messageTemplate.description: What a message template may contain and how long it may be.

blockTypes.description: The block types an agent may use, with their fields. "html" is not among them: a person edits that in the studio.

contexts.description: The data contexts the block needs (for example "booking" for booking-details).

fields.description: The fields of the block besides "id" and "type". Anything else is dropped when saving.

type.description: The type, as written in "type" of a block.

channels.description: The channels: "email", "sms". Chosen when creating, fixed afterwards.

contentFormat.description: The shape of "content" with an example for email and sms.

limits.description: The length and size limits of a template: name, subject, preheader, blocks per language, rich text, button label, URL, alternative text, image width and spacer height.

maxTemplates.description: At most this many templates per account.

note.description: One or two sentences for the user and for you: how to use the lists below.

partKinds.description: The kinds of process building blocks with exits, start ability, reference type and settings schema.

canFollow.description: Whether a block of this kind can follow another one.

canStart.description: Whether a block of this kind can start a process.

kind.description: The kind, as written in "kind" of a building block.

ports.description: The exits of the block, to write in "port" of a transition.

contexts.description: The data contexts a transition from this exit can use in conditions (for example "lead").

supportsDirect.description: Whether delivery "direct" is allowed from this exit.

receivesDelivery.description: Whether a transition into this kind carries a "delivery".

refType.description: What "ref" refers to: "funnel" (a form id), "appointmentType" (an appointment type id as text) or empty for no reference.

settingsSchema.description: JSON schema of "settings" for this kind. Fields an agent cannot set (a fixed recipient address) are left out.

uniquePerProcess.description: At most one block of this kind per process.

shortcodes.description: The shortcodes usable in message templates, with kind, needed contexts, whether they may go to visitors and their arguments.

allowed.description: The allowed values when the argument takes only fixed ones.

maxLength.description: Longest allowed value; 0 when not limited.

required.description: Whether it has to be given.

contexts.description: The data contexts the shortcode needs.

key.description: The shortcode without braces, for example "contact.firstname". Write it as {{contact.firstname}}.

visitorSafe.description: Whether a template with this shortcode may be sent to visitors.

status.description: Outcome. One of: "ok", "not_connected", "error". Authorisation can also refuse before the tool runs: "plan_required" (the account's plan does not include agent access), "not_enabled" (the account owner has not switched agent access on), "permission_denied" (the connected user's role lacks the permission; the note names it), "mandate_required" (the owner has not granted a mandate for this). The note then says what the user has to do.
